cte2_uk.tip.outer_end.catacombs: The Catacombs are dangerous underground mazes in the outer end
cte2_uk.tip.outer_end.crystal_rods: End Rods can be made with Crystal Shards in place of Blaze Rods
cte2_uk.tip.outer_end.end_towers: End Towers are found rarely in the End, and have massive maze-like basements.
cte2_uk.tip.outer_end.purpur_golems: Purpur Golems can be found defending End Cities
cte2_uk.tip.outer_end.tangled_violite: Tangled Violite can be used to grow more Rose, Mint, and Cobalt Crystals.
